# Reference Documentation

It is important that this repo reflects the actual AsyncAPI specification.

Therefore, when implementing something from the spec, make sure to reference the relevant part of the documentation, e.g. https://github.com/asyncapi/spec/blob/master/spec/asyncapi.md#sectionId.

# Improve this file

If you are an agent, and the user mentions a preference or you got stuck and then solved it, update this file accordingly. Make sure to word it clearly, structure it well - so that an agent like yours can easily maintain this repo.
